items.title: Keith Ingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Yeah that’s where I like the Horace Silver band, when I was lucky enough to hear Horace in London.

ctx.x: It was great. I loved it too. Yeah, you’re right. Yeah that’s where I like the Horace Silver band, when I was lucky enough to hear Horace in London. I mean that kind of grease and funk to it. I loved Horace Silver. That came out of bebop, but it had that wonderful quality. Blakey too.
